    Cancellation in the ray category of a distributive algebra #

    The ray category of a distributive algebra has left and right cancellation for nonzero composites (BGRS; the ported bgrsRayRepresentativeProduct_cancel_* lemmas). These are the hypotheses of the key lemma and of Fischbacher's reduction.
